Definition: from G1100 and the base of G2889; properly, a case (to keep mouthpieces of wind-instruments in) i.e. (by extension) a casket or (specially) purse:--bag.
BiblicalUsage: glōssókomon means bag. In John 12:6, the text says "and had the bag."
TheologicalSignificance: I take glōssókomon as it stands: bag.
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; The Anointing at Bethany
